results.content:
## 8. Casa C’Alma

Address: Praça das Flores 48 1º, 1200-192 Lisboa, Portugal

Why stay here: Prime Location

Rooms from $115 per night

In Praça das Flores, Casa C’Alma offers a boho-cool escape with five minimalist rooms. The Scandi-style design, bathed in natural light, features chalk-white walls, Beni Ourain rugs, and retro sofas. [...] The staff here are friendly and always willing to go the extra mile to make your stay memorable. The rooms are tastefully decorated with soft pops of color and feature abstract headboards and murals.

Even the standard rooms come equipped with espresso makers and Real Saboaria toiletries. Despite not being overly spacious or lavish, these rooms are incredibly comfortable and quiet, ensuring a good night’s rest.

## 12. Pestana Lisboa Vintage [...] Whether you’re traveling for business or pleasure, this hotel is a fantastic option that won’t break the bank.

## 13. Hotel Lis Baixa

Praca-do-Comercio-1 

Address: R. dos Douradores 146, 1100-107 Lisboa, Portugal

Why stay here: Historical center

Average price $128 per night

Located in the heart of Baixa, this charming hotel is situated on Rua dos Douradores, where goldsmiths once plied their trade. The hotel’s location is ideal for exploring all the nearby sights and attractions.
